'''Oppa''' was a tame and mischievous [[Momong/Legends|momong]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, Oppa was offered for sale as a pet by the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]], who operated a small stall within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The momong had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and grey [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TCWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This mischievous momong can be your partner in crime on your tour through the galaxy!|The store description in the game|<ref name="TCWA" />}}
Oppa first appeared as a purchasable pet in the [[2010]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. He could be bought from the game's store for 400 station cash, a premium in-game currency. As the purchase is optional, this article makes no assumptions about whether it occurred.
